meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体把网站部署到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用智能体自动部署网站到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let your agent deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically deploy websites to Vercel

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在 agent 容器里安装 Vercel CLI,并通过 OneCLI 自动注入 api.vercel.com 凭证,让 agent 能把网页应用部署到 Vercel。
howto.when: 当你想让 agent 把网页应用部署到 Vercel 时触发;前提是 OneCLI 已初始化,否则它会让你先运行 /init-onecli。

say.text: 把我这个网页应用部署到 Vercel 生产环境
列出我在 Vercel 上的部署
查一下 Vercel 当前的登录身份

howto.what_en: After install, Claude installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI to inject api.vercel.com credentials automatically, so the agent can deploy web applications to Vercel.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want the agent to deploy web applications to Vercel. It requires OneCLI to be set up first, otherwise it tells you to run /init-onecli.

say_en.text: Deploy this web app of mine to Vercel production
Check the current Vercel login identity
